title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful.

cards.title: Willis Reading Room
cards.subtitle: John Hay Library
cards.notes: Study in a grand, historic setting with high ceilings and long wooden tables. Access is available to Brown ID holders via card swipe at the accessible entrance.
cards.short_summary: A historic, quiet study hall within the John Hay Library known for its grand architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Willis Reading Room is located at the John Hay Library and is available for quiet study to Brown ID holders.
cards.access_notes: Open to Brown and RISD ID holders; check library site for seasonal hours and temporary closures.

cards.title: Friedman Study Center
cards.subtitle: Sciences Library
cards.notes: Utilize 27,000 square feet of collaborative and individual space. Level A features over 65 computers and expert technology consultants for student support.
cards.short_summary: A modern, multi-level study hub located at the base of the Sciences Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Friedman Study Center offers more than 27,000 square feet of study and social space on Level A of the Sciences Library.
cards.source_title: Friedman Study Center - Brown University Library
cards.access_notes: Swipe access required for entry; Level A is dedicated to study spaces.

cards.title: Rockefeller Library Carrels
cards.subtitle: Rockefeller Library
cards.notes: Reserve a designated quiet desk with shelves and power outlets. Carrels are located on the perimeter of the stacks on every level except the main floor.
cards.short_summary: Individual study desks located within the library stacks for focused, quiet work.
cards.evidence_claim: Carrels are study spaces for quiet, individual study located on the perimeter of the stacks at the Rockefeller Library.
cards.source_title: Reserve Rooms, Lockers and Carrels - Brown University Library
cards.access_notes: Active Brown students and faculty can reserve carrels; materials can be checked out to the carrel.

cards.title: Campus Center Common Spaces
cards.subtitle: Faunce House
cards.notes: Find a spot in the common rooms or lounges for impromptu study sessions. This central hub is open daily during the academic year starting at 7:00am.
cards.short_summary: A central social and study hub with various lounges and common areas for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stephen Robert '62 Campus Center has rooms and common spaces available for impromptu meetings and study use.
cards.source_title: Common Spaces | Student Activities | Brown University
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; hours are typically 7:00am to midnight during the academic year.

cards.title: Sidney E. Frank Digital Studio
cards.subtitle: Rockefeller Library
cards.notes: Access specialized equipment for digital scholarship and multimedia projects. This space supports the development and presentation of digital research.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused study space in the Rockefeller Library for digital project work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sidney E. Frank Digital Studio provides physical spaces for the development and support of digital scholarship.
cards.source_title: Programs and Spaces - Brown University Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Rockefeller Library; available during library hours.

cards.title: The Sunlab
cards.subtitle: CIT Building
cards.notes: Work in the primary computing facility for computer science students. It features over 70 Linux workstations and is often available late into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A high-capacity computer lab in the CIT building primarily for CS coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sunlab, located in CIT 143, is the primary computing resource for computer science undergraduates.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for students with CS course accounts; located in Room 143 of the CIT.

cards.title: MacMillan Reading Room
cards.subtitle: John Carter Brown Library
cards.notes: Study in a quiet, specialized environment by making a research appointment. This room is dedicated to consulting the library's rare book collections.
cards.short_summary: A specialized reading room for researchers at the John Carter Brown Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The John Carter Brown Library welcomes researchers to consult collections in the W. Duncan MacMillan Reading Room by appointment.
cards.source_title: Reading Room Appointments - John Carter Brown Library
cards.access_notes: Appointments are required for all research visits; open Monday-Friday with limited hours.

cards.title: Multimedia Lab
cards.subtitle: Granoff Center
cards.notes: Use this creative space for multidisciplinary work and digital production. The center is designed to catalyze collaboration across arts and sciences.
cards.short_summary: A creative lab space in the Granoff Center for arts and technology projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Granoff Center features a multimedia lab and flexible production spaces for multidisciplinary work.
cards.source_title: The Perry and Marty Granoff Center for the Creative Arts
cards.access_notes: Open to Brown ID holders; check building hours for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Orwig Music Library
cards.subtitle: Young Orchard Avenue
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot among the music collections and scores. This library provides a specialized environment for music-related study and research.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, specialized library focused on music scores and recordings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Orwig Music Library holds materials supporting music study and research and is restricted to Brown and RISD ID holders.
cards.source_title: Orwig Music Library - Brown University Library
cards.access_notes: Swipe access required; check website for current operating hours.

cards.title: Racial Justice Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Rockefeller Library
cards.notes: Gather for research and learning in this dedicated space on the second floor. It is designed for the Brown community to advance ideas of racial justice.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated space in the Rockefeller Library for research and gathering around racial justice.
cards.evidence_claim: The Racial Justice Resource Center is located on the second floor of the Rockefeller Library for research and gathering.
cards.source_title: Programs and Spaces - Brown University Library
cards.access_notes: Available to members of the Brown community during library hours.
